mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, strategy_case_id, forecast_run_id, notification_type, severity, title, message, deduplication_key, read_yn, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT #{userId}, #{strategyCaseId}, NULL, #{notificationType}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{message}, #{deduplicationKey}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{userId}, 0 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification existing WHERE existing.user_id = #{userId} AND existing.deduplication_key = #{deduplicationKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT candidate.strategy_case_id, candidate.requester_id, candidate.case_name, candidate.final_status, candidate.generation_stage FROM ( SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.created_by AS requester_id, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.generation_stage, CASE WHEN strategy_case.case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED' THEN 'GENERATION_FAILED' ELSE 'GENERATED' END AS final_status, strategy_case.completed_at FROM strategy_case WHERE strategy_case.completed_at >= #{completedFrom} AND strategy_case.created_by IS NOT NULL AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 AND ( strategy_case.case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED' OR strategy_case.generation_stage = 'COMPARISON_READY' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification existing WHERE existing.user_id = strategy_case.created_by AND existing.deduplication_key = 'AI_STRATEGY:' || strategy_case.strategy_case_id || ':' || CASE WHEN strategy_case.case_status = 'GENERATION_FAILED' THEN 'GENERATION_FAILED' ELSE 'GENERATED' END ) ORDER BY strategy_case.completed_at, strategy_case.strategy_case_id ) candidate WHERE ROWNUM <= #{batchSize}
